components.name: Primary button
components.description: Explicit action in the exchange workspace.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:550;text-decoration:none;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out;font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:13.02px;background:var(--accent,#2449b3);color:#fff;}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover,#193685);color:#fff;}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#2449b3);outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}

components.description: Low-emphasis action with an explicit label.

components.name: Labelled input
components.description: Persistent label and visible focus for exact entry.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-quantity">Quantity</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-quantity" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="1">
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-size:12.6px;font-weight:600;margin:20px 0 8px;color:var(--ink,#202725)}.ds-input{font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:14px;width:100%;border:1px solid #b8c1b8;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#202725);border-radius:6px;padding:11px 12px;min-height:44px;line-height:1.4;caret-color:var(--accent,#2449b3)}.ds-input:hover{border-color:#7d8c7f}.ds-input[readonly]{background:#f3f4f1}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#2449b3);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Active route combines color, underline, and aria-current.
components.html: MarketMy portfolioTraders
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:32px;min-height:56px;font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;font-size:14px;}.ds-nav a{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted,#626b67);font-weight:550;white-space:nowrap}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink,#202725)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--accent,#2449b3)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;height:3px;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;left:0;right:0;background:var(--accent,#2449b3)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#2449b3);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
A restrained exchange workspace puts changing prices, account constraints, and deliberate actions in clear view. Warm off-white ground supports white working surfaces, dark ink, and a deep blue action accent. This descriptive north-star name is a provisional label for the approved direction, not a separately approved identity.

Density comes from aligned tables and compact controls, with space between task groups. A single sans-serif stack, quiet dividers, and ordinary navigation support precise scanning. Numerical hierarchy carries the work; decoration stays subordinate.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ground with white working surfaces.
Blue actions and active states; explicit buy/sell language.
Inline trading controls and local table scrolling.

rules.name: The Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Use deep blue for actions, active navigation, and selection; keep buy/sell labels explicit.

rules.name: The Numerical Alignment Rule
rules.body: Right-align prices and quantities with tabular numerals; retain readable labels beside account values.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate working regions with tone, spacing, and fine borders. Reserve the existing small shadow for the selected order-side control.

dos: Do keep persistent field labels, visible focus, and text explanations for errors.
Do stack trading sections and contain wide tables in labelled scroll regions on narrow screens.
Do keep account constraints adjacent to the order form.
donts: Don't replace useful trading data with decorative charts, gradients, or ornamental motion.
Don't rely on semantic color alone to communicate buy/sell or profit/loss.
Don't add separate panels around every individual value.
